items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1958-12-10
items.q: Robson, you want to play trombone? I said, yes, sir... I just take me and him both

ctx.x: I took a chance, man, walk up there.

Lieutenant, Fire Lieutenant, they named Lieutenant Lyons, too. I said, all right, Robson, you want to play trombone? I said, yes, sir. I said, all right. I said, well, give me a brand new chord on trombone. So I just took it and put it together, you know. But I could pull it up, understand? Well, every day, so after, they had a fella who was working with the band, but it was three or four weeks, and he couldn't even pull his horn up.
